manifest.name: customer-import-run
manifest.description: One customer-data import. A preview run writes nothing at all, so every row here belongs to an applied run. The idempotency key is business-derived from the system, the mapping fingerprint and the canonical digest of the rows - never from a clock or a random value - so a retry of the same payload returns this same run, and a different payload under the same key is a conflict rather than an adoption.

migrations.name: create_customer_import_runs
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_import_runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  idempotency_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  system TEXT,
  mapping TEXT,
  mapping_version INTEGER,
  mapping_fingerprint TEXT,
  policy TEXT,
  policy_version INTEGER,
  policy_fingerprint TEXT,
  acceptance TEXT CHECK(acceptance IN ('partial', 'all_or_nothing')),
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('applied', 'refused')),
  row_count INTEGER,
  accepted_count INTEGER,
  rejected_count INTEGER,
  skipped_count INTEGER,
  candidate_count INTEGER,
  issue_count INTEGER,
  actor_type TEXT CHECK(actor_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  applied_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customer_import_runs_status ON customer_import_runs(status);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_customer_import_runs
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."customer_import_runs" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "idempotency_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "system" TEXT,
  "mapping" TEXT,
  "mapping_version" BIGINT,
  "mapping_fingerprint" TEXT,
  "policy" TEXT,
  "policy_version" BIGINT,
  "policy_fingerprint" TEXT,
  "acceptance" TEXT CHECK("acceptance" IN ('partial', 'all_or_nothing')),
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('applied', 'refused')),
  "row_count" BIGINT,
  "accepted_count" BIGINT,
  "rejected_count" BIGINT,
  "skipped_count" BIGINT,
  "candidate_count" BIGINT,
  "issue_count" BIGINT,
  "actor_type" TEXT CHECK("actor_type" IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  "actor_id" TEXT,
  "applied_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "customer_import_runs_status"
  ON "accordo"."customer_import_runs"("status");
